HIGH COURT OF DELHI: NEW DELHI
EXAMINATION BRANCH – NON JUDICIAL
No.92/Exams-NJ/DHC
Date:28. 10.2026
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all concerned that Stage–I: English Typing Test in
connection with Senior Personal Assistant (Open) Examination–2026, will be held as per the
following schedule:-
Date of Examination
14. 11.2026 (Saturday)
City of Examination
Delhi-NCR
It is further notified that the details of reporting time, examination time, centre of
examination and instructions to candidates, etc. will be as per the Admit Card. Further, the
candidates are advised to visit the official website of this Court
viz. www.delhihighcourt.nic.in regularly, for further updates.
Sd/-
(Dalip Kumar Bajaj)
Deputy Registrar
Examination Branch (Non-Judicial)
